description: Angular component for an HTML editor with Ace integration, including validation, resize handling, and beautification features.

classes.name: HtmlComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a rich HTML editing interface with syntax highlighting, validation, and formatting.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the Ace editor, sets up event handlers and resize observers.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observers and destroys the Ace editor instance.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the Ace editor when the container size changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the editor value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the editor to read-only mode based on disabled state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the editor content, returns validation errors if any.

methods.name: beautifyHtml
methods.description: Formats the HTML content with proper indentation.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Updates the editor with a new value programmatically.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Syncs the editor content with the model and triggers change propagation.
